question: Should the persisted optional `WorkspaceTab.layout` field ship under workspace schemaVersion 1 even though older strict validators may reject documents after a downgrade?
rationale: The implementation is mechanically sound, but whether the workspace document format is forward-only or must support downgrade or rolling-version reads is a repository compatibility decision not established by the patch.

options.title: Confirm additive schema v1
options.body: Document that Workspaces documents are forward-only across downgrade and allow the optional field to remain under schemaVersion 1.

options.title: Version and migrate
options.body: Advance the workspace document version and add the explicit migration or compatibility behavior required by the supported upgrade contract.

recommendation.title: Confirm additive schema v1
recommendation.body: Document that Workspaces documents are forward-only across downgrade and allow the optional field to remain under schemaVersion 1.
